title: Oil Prices Fall Sharply After Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Is Open
partialText: But analysts said it was not clear how quickly the oil industry in the Persian Gulf would be able to get back to normal.

title: Marie-Thérèse Ross-Mahé, Detained by ICE in Alabama, Is Released
partialText: Marie-Thérèse Ross-Mahé, 85, who was arrested amid an inheritance dispute, has returned to France, its foreign affairs minister said. She came to America last year after reconnecting with and marrying a former G.I.

title: She Made Sure Her Baby Was Born an American. Then Federal Agents Separated Them.
partialText: Diana Acosta Verde, who came into the United States illegally when she was six months pregnant, had to leave her baby at a hospital while she returned to a detention center.

title: Rumeysa Ozturk, Tufts Student Held in Immigration Detention, Returns to Turkey
partialText: Rumeysa Ozturk, who was detained for weeks by the Trump administration after co-writing a pro-Palestinian opinion essay, has graduated and returned home.

title: The 27-Year-Old Diplomat Waging Trump’s Cultural War With Europe
partialText: Five years out of college, Samuel Samson has driven the Trump administration’s push to upend America’s postwar relationship with Europe.

title: We Need Lena Dunham Now More Than Ever
partialText: The era of “Girls” is long gone. Its creator still has much to teach us.

title: In ‘Famesick,’ Lena Dunham Diagnoses Celebrity, Illness and Herself
partialText: This unusually unfiltered memoir takes us to the hospital, to therapy and to the sometimes hostile set of “Girls.”

title: Aging in a Brightly Lit, Big City: Jay McInerney, With a New Novel
partialText: In 1984, Jay McInerney was a famous, young, hedonistic novelist. Now 71, he is wistful as he wraps up his tetralogy about a couple whose city, and marriage, are tested by the pandemic.

title: House Votes to Extend Expiring FISA Surveillance Law for 10 Days
partialText: The Senate approved a stopgap measure that passed the House early Friday. Libertarian-leaning House Republicans had balked at a long-term extension.

title: Texas Democrat James Talarico Is Out-Raising His G.O.P. Opponents
partialText: James Talarico, the Democratic nominee, has been amassing campaign cash as Senator John Cornyn and Attorney General Ken Paxton still battle each other.

title: Trump Tries to Stop Drug Smuggling From South America. Drug Smugglers Invent New Tactics.
partialText: Authorities are using drones, troops and A.I. to crack down on cocaine smuggling. But gangs are finding new ways to move record amounts of drugs across the world.

title: Supreme Court Sides With Oil Companies in Louisiana Coastal Lawsuits
partialText: The companies had asked the justices to clear the way to move environmental lawsuits out of state courts, to friendlier federal venues.

title: How the D4vd Case and Rumors Captivated the Public Before the Singer’s Arrest
partialText: A teenage girl went missing. The police found her remains in a musician’s car. Then the Los Angeles media machine got to work.

title: D4vd Arrested in Connection With Death of Celeste Rivas Hernandez
partialText: The singer was detained in connection with the death of Celeste Rivas Hernandez, who died before her 15th birthday. D4vd’s lawyers said they would vigorously defend his innocence.

title: Who Are D4vd and Celeste Rivas Hernandez?
partialText: The musician is known for creating the anthem for Fortnite. He was touring for his major-label debut when Ms. Rivas Hernandez’s remains were found in his car, officials said.

title: A Family Feud at an Oregon Winery Turns to Vinegar Over A.I. Slop
partialText: She wanted to pry her late mother’s vineyard from two of her brothers. Instead, her lawyers were fined nearly $110,000 for citing bogus case law generated by artificial intelligence.

title: A Century Later, the Flatiron’s Revolving Door Is Restored
partialText: The revolving door’s inventor built this one over 100 years ago. It was reinstalled this week.

title: A Paris Court Just Rewrote the Rules of Corporate Morality
partialText: The profit motive was on trial. The verdict was scathing.

title: Our Tax System Should Make You Furious
partialText: The tax expert Ray Madoff explains why the American tax system is broken, and how to make it fairer.

title: A Huge Arch
partialText: President Trump wants to build one, but he’s getting pushback.

title: Stephen Colbert Delights in Trump’s ‘Ongoing Papal Feud’
partialText: The host of “The Late Show” recapped what he called “yet another day when the entire world is on edge over President Trump’s senseless and elective war — with the pope.”

title: Midwest Forecast to See Strong Storms on Friday
partialText: The Midwest has faced day after day of weather warnings this week. More are expected on Friday.

title: Help for Medicare Advantage Patients Who Lose Doctors Is Shelved, for Now
partialText: Nationwide, hospitals and other providers are leaving private Medicare Advantage plans, putting thousands of seniors at risk of higher costs and of losing trusted doctors.

title: Starmer Fires Senior U.K. Civil Servant Over Mandelson Revelations
partialText: Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s office confirmed that Peter Mandelson, a Jeffrey Epstein associate, failed security checks before he became Britain’s envoy to Washington.
